output.reason: The brief fits the timing well: the step change came the week of 12 August, Pod D (still on the old server) saw no rise, and core and agency staff were affected equally, all of which points to the relay migration rather than staffing; the next steps are clear, though I can't check the cited forwarding-rule and notification data myself, and the Room 14 missed-ring issue is left unresolved.
